summary.intent: Mark phase 46 and 47 todos as complete after verifying delivery, capture a follow-up todo for shared folder writes, and record a successful Linux UAT for phase 46's stale-mount recovery requirement.
summary.outcome: All 10 todos moved to completed/ (pending count 19→9), ROADMAP scope boxes checked, STATE.md updated, a new shared-write todo captured, and phase 46 UAT confirmed and recorded in 46-VERIFICATION.md. All commits pushed to PR #494.

repo: Planning system lives in .planning/ with subdirs: todos/pending/, todos/completed/, phases/, STATE.md, and ROADMAP.
ROADMAP has two distinct checkbox types: 'Scope (captured todos)' boxes and plan checkboxes — only scope boxes should be checked when marking todos done.
Phase verification docs (.planning/phases/<phase>/46-VERIFICATION.md) carry a human_needed flag for items requiring manual UAT that can't be unit-verified.
The project uses lint-staged with Touch ID-gated GPG signing on commits.
Merging origin/main into the feature branch was required before verifying phase 46 todos because the phase's directory and code were only present after merge.

code.finding: REQ-3 (stale-mount recovery after SIGKILL) had a human_needed flag requiring Linux remount UAT; code and unit tests landed but runtime path needed a real Linux machine to confirm.
Tracks pending todo count and phase UAT status; updated to reflect 19→9 pending todos and phase 46 UAT pass.

workflow: git mv is the correct tool for moving todos to completed/ so renames are staged automatically.
Background commits with task notifications allow async Touch ID approval without blocking the session.
A transient 'could not write index' git error from lint-staged resolved cleanly on retry — no manual recovery needed beyond confirming no lock file remained.
lint-staged creates a backup stash on failure; stash cleanup happens automatically so manual stash pop is not needed after a transient error.

friction: lint-staged threw a transient 'could not write index' error on the UAT commit, causing it to fail with exit code 1 and requiring a diagnostic pass before retrying.
The phase 46 merge was a prerequisite for local verification that wasn't initially in scope — merging origin/main mid-session added an unplanned step.
